project_context.tagline: For the Farmers, With the Farmer, To the Farmer, HAMESHA
project_context.objective: Create a premium agricultural machinery website that positions KrishiGears as a trusted supplier of farming equipment across India.
project_context.target_market: Farmers, Agricultural Equipment Dealers, Farm Contractors, Retailers, Agricultural Input Stores, Government Tenders, Institutional Buyers

theme_and_archetype.justification: KrishiGears needs a 'Command-Center' focus. Dark mode combined with high-visibility Lime Green conveys elite athleticism and precision but tailored for raw industrial agricultural power. It distances the brand from cheap consumer goods and positions it as a premium, heavy-duty machinery supplier.
theme_and_archetype.emotional_tone: Trustworthy, rugged, authoritative, precise, and tech-forward.

rules: No pure #000000 or #808080. Greys are tinted with slight warmth or coolness. Using Zinc/Neutral tailwind palettes.

Lime green (#84CC16) is used EXCLUSIVELY for key kinetic triggers (Primary CTAs, active states, active tab indicators, tracing beams). Do not use it for large background fills unless it's a specific banner.
Text on primary lime green backgrounds MUST be Black (#000000) or very dark grey (#0A0A0A) to meet APCA contrast ratios.

headings.rules: H1 max text-5xl to text-6xl. Do not use generic sans for headings.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous spacing: p-6, p-8, p-12, p-20, p-32.

grids.marketing_sections: MODE A: 'Tetris' Bento Grid for category showcases and Why Choose Us sections. Asymmetrical grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 with gap-8. Mix tall and wide cards.
grids.catalog_specs: MODE B: 'Control Room' Grid for Product Specifications and features. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4. High density, explicit borders.

surfaces.headers: Glassmorphism: bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl with a border-b border-white/10.
surfaces.cards: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). border border-zinc-800 bg-[#141414]. Hover states lift slightly (-translate-y-1) and cast a subtle lime glow shadow.
surfaces.inputs: Flat, dark fields (bg-[#0A0A0A]) with sharp 1px borders (border-zinc-800) and lime green focus rings (focus:ring-lime-500).

components_strategy.general: Hybrid approach. Pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing layouts. Shadcn UI for forms, dialogues, and complex interactions.
components_strategy.navigation: Sticky top nav. bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl. Logo left, links center, Dealer/Contact CTA right. Always visible on desktop.
components_strategy.buttons: Sharp corners or very slight radius (rounded-md). Primary: bg-lime-500 text-black hover:bg-lime-400. Secondary: bg-transparent border border-zinc-700 text-white hover:border-lime-500 hover:text-lime-500.
components_strategy.forms: Use Shadcn Input, Select, Textarea. Dark theme overrides. Forms must look like high-end technical command interfaces.
components_strategy.tables: Spec tables use border-collapse, visible grid lines (border-zinc-800), alternating row subtle backgrounds.
components_strategy.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='submit-enquiry-button').

hero_background.description: Dark mode studio lighting of agricultural machinery. Use as the main hero background with a heavy bg-black/50 to bg-black/70 overlay to ensure the lime green tagline pops.

india_network_map.description: Stylized glowing map of India showing dealer network.

abstract_terrain.description: Abstract dark topographic map. Use as background for CTA bands or About sections.

farmer_field_2.description: Indian farmer laboring in paddy field

home: Hero: Large H1 tagline 'For the Farmers, With the Farmer, To the Farmer, HAMESHA'. Use hero_background image with gradient overlay.
Category Grid: Present the 19 categories using a Bento grid style or a sleek horizontal scrolling marquee for smaller items. Do not just use a boring symmetrical grid.
Dealer Network: Showcase the india_network_map image with stats (e.g., 'Pan India Support', 'Subsidy Approved').
Floating Actions: Add a fixed bottom-right WhatsApp button (bg-green-500) and a mobile-only call button.
products: Use technical/grid border styling for product cards.
Each product page must have a 'Command Center' specs table. Expose technical details clearly.
Include a 'Request Bulk Order' or 'Enquiry' CTA prominently on product detail pages.
about_and_network: Use farmer_field images. Contrast the high-tech machinery aesthetic with grounded, human farmer stories.
Highlight 'FMTTI Approved' and 'Subsidy Approved' as trust badges.

instructions_to_main_agent: Set up Tailwind config with the custom colors: background, surface, border, and primary lime (zinc-based greys + lime-500).
Create the specific product categories listed in the requirements exactly as provided (Power Tillers, Power Weeders, Brush Cutters, etc.).
Implement pure HTML/Tailwind for the dynamic bento layouts on the marketing homepage, and use Shadcn for the forms and inputs.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, form inputs, and major navigation links.
Ensure dark mode is forced or is the default theme across the application.
